title: God’s beginning cannot be found
english: God’s beginning cannot be found. Creatures never grasp it. Only the Savior and the Holy Spirit, forever with God, see his face; and [[angels always behold the face of the Father in heaven >> Bible:Matthew 18:10]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Scheck FOTC Isaiah/Ezekiel (Isaiah).

title: The whole earth full of his glory
english: [[The whole earth is full of his glory >> Bible:Isaiah 6:3]] — not only the temple house. [[The thresholds shook at the voice of those who called, and the house was filled with smoke >> Bible:Isaiah 6:4]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.

title: I saw the King, the Lord of hosts
english: [[My eyes have seen the King, the Lord of hosts >> Bible:Isaiah 6:5]]. Vision drives confession: [[Woe is me, for I am a man of unclean lips >> Bible:Isaiah 6:5]].
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.

title: Seraphim coal cleanses the lips
english: [[One of the Seraphim flew to me with a live coal >> Bible:Isaiah 6:6]]; [[it touched my mouth; your guilt is taken away >> Bible:Isaiah 6:7]]. Cleansed lips can preach. Glory to God. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 33 / Origenes Werke VIII (1925), Jerome Latin.
